components.name: EMA-Nesterov lookahead buffer (EMA of per-step displacement)

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding and LM head, bias-correction-free Adam m and v on 1-D params, plus EMA-Nesterov prev_params and lookahead buffer on all of them; the tail EMA also covers the LM head and 1-D params (≈0.50 of A, embedding excluded)
notes: Same optimizer state as #44 plus one tail-EMA buffer (τ=150, clone of fp32 params) of all non-embedding params, kept from step 2000 to the 2720 stop and blended in place (p.lerp_(ema, 0.6)) at 2720. The default-off hooks allocate nothing in the logged runs (MUON_HISTORY_STEPS=0 returns before muon_history_buffer is created; readout anchor, TrailDelta and the tail-EMA sweep are off).
evidence: should_soap_param: return is_mlp_fc or is_mlp_proj or is_attn_proj or is_qkv (all hidden)
SOAP params: state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=torch.float32); state["row_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(0), p.size(0)); state["col_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(1), p.size(1))
soap_update_preconditioner: q_row/q_col = soap_eigenbasis(...) on first call, then soap_basis_qr every step (SOAP_PRECONDITION_FREQUENCY = 1) replacing q_row, q_col, exp_avg_sq
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight], [proj.weight], fused=True); optimizer3 = Adam(1-D groups): state["exp_avg"] = zeros_like(p), state["exp_avg_sq"] = zeros_like(p, fp32)
maybe_update_tail_ema: tail_ema = {tau: {n: p.detach().clone() for n, p in tail_ema_scoped} for tau in TAIL_EMA_TAUS} at step 2000, then bufs[n].lerp_(p, 1/tau)
TAIL_EMA_TAUS default "150" (one buffer), TAIL_EMA_SCOPE "nonembed"; log: 'tail_ema initialized step:2000 taus:[150.0]', 'tail_ema applied step:2720'
apply_muon_history: if MUON_HISTORY_STEPS <= 0: return update (before state["muon_history_buffer"] would be allocated)
